P1.rule: arm A fine strict kappa vs majority within [0.25, 0.43] for >= 2 of 3 models, and seam lift (A - before) > off-seam lift for >= 2 of 3

P2.rule: seam subset, fine strict: B exceeds both A and C by >= 0.05 and |C - A| <= 0.05, for >= 2 of 3 models

P3.rule: |C - A| <= 0.05 strict at every grain, overall and seam, for every model

P4.rule: graded kappa > strict kappa at every grain, every arm and model (overall)

length_not_reading.rule: |B - C| <= 0.05 on the seam subset (fine strict) for >= 2 of 3 models: the B lift is prompt length

priming.rule: B - A >= 0.05 off the seams and the off-seam lift >= the seam lift (fine strict), for >= 2 of 3 models: priming, not reading

flat_B.rule: |B - A| <= 0.05 strict at every grain, overall and seam, for every model: evidence about content cues on this corpus only, not about the catalogue
